comments.body:
The testing team believes it's a good moment to give a short presentation introducing the relatively new [ethereum/execution-spec-tests](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests) repo, explain the motivation behind it and how to use it for test case development.

The aim is to encourage client teams to take advantage of these tests whilst implementing new features and to collaborate with us by submitting (test) ideas, finding coverage holes and implementing new tests.

I'd like to discuss:

1) moving the 4844 precompile address so things are "tightly packed" https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7172
2) if we can get agreement this will be the last update on 4788, which bounds the storage consumed by the construction https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7178

> The testing team believes it's a good moment to give a short presentation introducing the relatively new [ethereum/execution-spec-tests](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests) repo, explain the motivation behind it and how to use it for test case development.
> 
> The aim is to encourage client teams to take advantage of these tests whilst implementing new features and to collaborate with us by submitting (test) ideas, finding coverage holes and implementing new tests.

Great, because I also wanted to talk about it. In particular (no need to answer here):

1. How are you going to cooperate with / migrate from ethereum/tests?
2. What are the plans to state test format?

A couple of Engine API things I'd like to cover:
* Last call for https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/420
* Procedure to deprecate `exchangeTransitionConfiguration`, https://hackmd.io/@n0ble/deprecate-exchgTC
Quick notes on full featured CL spec release
